programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "Ruling the Waves: Battle of the Atlantic"
programme.sub-title: Ruling the Waves: Battle of the Atlantic
programme.desc: The use of computer graphics and combat footage highlights the significant role of Allied aircraft in neutralizing Nazi Germany's Atlantic naval power, including the destruction of the Bismark.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Doolittle Raid: 18 April 1942"
programme.desc: Operation Shangri-la, a 1942 bombing raid on Tokyo by Lt. Col. James Doolittle's 16 Mitchell B-25s, was a significant American morale booster following Allied Pacific disasters, though its military significance was minimal.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Eastern Front 1941-45"
programme.desc: The text addresses the conflict between Hitler's Luftwaffe and the Soviet Air Force, highlighting that despite initial outclassing, Stalin's pilots eventually achieved parity with Allied assistance.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "The Best of Part 1"
programme.desc: Brendan Moar is here to uncover the people and machinery behind the worlds most dangerous and captivating demolitions.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Bath"
programme.desc: In this episode an intensive operation takes place to bring down a beast of a building, Harworth Colliery.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Doncaster"
programme.desc: In this episode an intensive operation takes place to bring down a huge and unusual structure.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "China"
programme.desc: We visit China's most famous Wind and Rain Bridge and the Ponte dei Salti in the Verzasca Valley that literally dates back to the Roman era.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Deadliest Weapons"
programme.desc: As the battle distance continued to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millenia to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Navigating The Globe"
programme.desc: This episode dives into the pioneering breakthroughs from across the globe that have shaped our ability to travel.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Tools & Tech"
programme.desc: Delve into the history of technology; from a simple rock to the invention of modern computing.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Anatomy of the House"
programme.desc: From living in caves to grand mansions, shelter has always been high on the list of our priorities. Bur form and function varies wildly throughout civilizations.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Tractors"
programme.desc: In this episode Francesca Chiorando goes inside the largest tractor factory in the UK to see how they build their newest bespoke tractor.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Vespa"
programme.desc: In this episode of Ultimate Processes Francesca Chiorando goes inside the Vespa factory in Italy - to see how they build their iconic scooters.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Waterford"
programme.desc: Francesca finds out how the world famous Waterford crystal is made and gets to try out glass blowing and glass cutting with surprising results.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Helicopters"
programme.desc: In this episode of Ultimate Processes, we investigate how the AW 101, one of the world’s most advanced search and rescue helicopters is designed and built.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programme.desc: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programme.desc: In this exciting episode we’ll find out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how we can prevent them. Cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send our hosts, our stunt team and our special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: Military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition. Bottom line, a ton of cool shooting and science for Nick and Laura to explore!

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Lightning Strike"
programme.desc: Laura and Nick travel to a state-of-the-art Direct Effects Lightning Test Lab. With some “explosive” experiments, they’ll determine the power lightning and how it behaves? And they’ll find out how can hunters and fishermen best protect themselves?

programme.title: The Blind Monkey
programme.desc: China's Taihang Mountains are a tough place to be a baby monkey, especially if your blind. Follow the two-year saga of love and compassion that defies all odds with the extreme devotion of one macaque mother.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Meteorites"
programme.desc: In this episode we go back in time to the edge of a 50.000-year crater. On a highway to Arizona, we followed the sign 'Meteor Crater'. This was the start for a fantastic tour to rocks from another world.

programme.title: Borneo's Pygmy Elephants
programme.desc: Borneo’s diminutive pygmy forest elephants were always thought to be a feral population derived from domesticated Asian elephants. Now, though, DNA testing has confirmed that they are a unique subspecies who’ve lived on Borneo for at least 300,000 years.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Ringtailed Rascals"
programme.desc: We're fascinated by the Jaguar's spots, the Skunk's stripes, and the Raccoon's mask and Ringtailed. Maybe it's because these characteristic markings enable us to identify them easier and they even add an extra dimension to their personalities.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Wild Turkey Part 1"
programme.desc: A creature chosen by the Pilgrims for the first Thanksgiving meal that's now a rarity in Nature. Our largest gamebird with its flamboyant courtship.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Wild Turkey Part 2"
programme.desc: Part 2 continues to explore the wild turkey as one of game management's greatest success stories. Our traditional symbol of Nature's abundance was once feared to be gone as a gamebird due to overhunting by humans and a loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Bobcat"
programme.desc: Prey can become play, for this solitary hunter sometimes pesters its captured quarry to death. Easily confused with its cousin, the Lynx, the Bobcat flourishes in close proximity to humans.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "The Grouse and the Goshawk"
programme.desc: Intimately linked together are two birds -- the speedy Goshawk and the alert Ruffed Grouse. Many predators pursue the Grouse, but none is so well-adapted to catch it as the Goshawk.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Lizards"
programme.desc: Over hundreds of millions of years, they existed here long before us. Surviving natural disasters and mass extinctions, the are now among the oldest animals on earth.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Penguins"
programme.desc: Despite popularity, it seems the future does not bode well for the penguins, finding themselves in a shrinking world of melting snow and ice. However, they remain on the shores of our beaches and on the unforgiving Antarctic ice shelves and oceans.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Bears"
programme.desc: Bears today are divided into 8 species with some considered the largest land predators, though many are in fact omnivorous. They survive in our grasslands and mountains, tropical jungles and the cold harsh climate of the Artic.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Turtles"
programme.desc: 27 species of turtles today are on the very brink of becoming extinct, with over 240 additional species being threatened or critically endangered.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: It’s a race against time to bring in the world’s biggest animal – the elephant. It’s gone down in a bad position and has stopped breathing. There’s a baby boom out on the reserve – we are lucky enough to watch the birth of a giraffe.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 6"
programme.desc: An adult leopard has been caught in a trap on a nearby farm and it's a very dangerous rescue. It’s playtime at the Animal Hospital when Themba gets a new toy, and the work experience student almost ends up squashed by nearly a ton of antelope.
